title: POST /auth/session extends the session server-side and never sets a session cookie (option C, follow-up to RF-177)
acceptance: POST /api/v1/auth/session with a session older than Better Auth updateAge returns 200 with no Set-Cookie and moves the session row's expires_at later; the same unchanged cookie then authenticates an ordinary route (integration test).

A session younger than updateAge is left unchanged; ordinary requireSession routes resolve with refresh disabled and leave an aged row unchanged; no /api/v1 response, 200 or 401, carries a session Set-Cookie (integration and unit tests).
Better Auth's own GET /api/auth/get-session still refreshes and sets the cookie for browsers (integration test).

OpenAPI has no Set-Cookie header on /auth/session, and api.md, authorization.md and conventions.md say native clients keep the cookie with no client-side expiry, /auth/session extends the server session and a 401 means signed out; the iOS web-contract snapshots are refreshed in a separate iOS PR.
nextAction: Session on branch fix/rf-178-session-refresh-no-cookie (worktree lanes/web-rf-177b): open the owner-gated PR and set the final state.

evidence.summary: Owner decision after the RF-177 post-merge design review: the owner said "Go with C" in the Air session on 2026-11-02 (recorded on #703). C: /auth/session keeps refreshing the row server-side but forwards no Set-Cookie; iOS stores the cookie without client-side expiry and relies on the server's 401.
RF-177 (merged as 1897a6d): POST /auth/session forwarded the refresh Set-Cookie, which URLSession applies on its own, so a stale response for account A could overwrite account B's cookie.
iOS RF-1012 carries the iOS half: store the cookie without expiry, call /auth/session at launch and foreground, treat 401 as signed out, log failed sign-out.

On main's middleware (1897a6d) the three /auth/session cases fail (it set a Set-Cookie); with this change all 18 integration cases pass, and apps/api/src/middleware/auth.test.ts (4 cases) pins disableRefresh on ordinary routes and that refreshSession never requests or forwards Better Auth's headers.
